svg.text: macOS eGPU Boot Flow — RX 9070 XT / gfx1201
Apple Silicon Mac ⟶ Thunderbolt 4 ⟶ Razer Core X V2 ⟶ Navi 48 (SOC22)
DMA bus addr ⟶ host phys page
• 1 MB SOS staging buffer (freed after load)
• 4 KB PSP cmd + 4 KB fence buf
DART maps each to a bus-visible address
Data highways from host to GPU
MMIO (register plane): Python → DEXT escape → PCIe BAR5 (512 KB) → GPU regs. Used for every C2PMSG_*, RLC_CNTL, GFX_IMU_*, MM_INDEX/MM_DATA…
DMA (firmware + mailbox): alloc_dma → DART → bus addr 0x8000_0000+ → GPU reads over PCIe. Used for SOS components, PSP ring, SMU fw, fence/cmd bufs.
BAR0 VRAM window (256 MB): Python mmap(BAR0) → CPU pointer → slice-copy into low VRAM. Used to build the 23 MB gfx12 autoload buffer.
BAR2 doorbell (2 MB): reserved for compute-queue submission (later phase, not hot today).
Thunderbolt 4 · PCIe 3.0 x4 (ReBAR OFF → 256 MB VRAM BAR)
② Razer Core X V2 · RX 9070 XT (dev 0x7551 rev 0xC0)
Navi 48 · gfx1201 · GC 12.0.1 · SMU/PSP 14.0.3 · MMHUB 4.1.0 · SDMA 7.0.1 · NBIO 6.3.1
KM ring created, FW loads OK
PSP v14.0.3 · SOS, IMU via LOAD_IP_FW
Current blocker — no GC writes take
waiting for IMU to release it
MP0 & MP1 share the same 15 bases
32 GB HBM / GDDR6 VRAM · [0x80_0000_0000 … 0x87_F700_0000] MC range
— enough to reach all the above.
partial · skeleton present, not on hot path
